native_mechanisms: A chained line of prisoners grinds a blank pillar mark by mark, each stroke's angle (rotate-then-add, never a multiply, never a look at the mark) carried forward from every stroke before it through the closed chain.
One in-order flood that does not recede until every mark has passed bends anchored wire shapes, each wire taking the same per-pass angle but with its own rotation/key so each leans differently.
The token is the single fixed silhouette the wires cast once the flood drains and shivering stops — one read, one shape kept, inputs/pillar/water all discarded and unrecoverable.
core_technique: Multiply-free ARX core loop over 64-byte stripes: 8 keyed lanes each doing xor-with-data, rotate by a lane-specific constant, then add the previous pass's neighbouring lane (circulant lane-to-lane carry), with the only multiplications in a one-shot mul128-fold merge plus fmix64 finalizer (xxh3-style framing: keyed secret, overlapping last stripe, short-input path).
